README: Hand-maintained Forever overrides for Questie's quest blacklist (docs/P2_GUIDE_ENGINE_SPEC.md 8a). Add an entry ONLY with in-game evidence from WoW Forever. action "unblacklist": Questie hides the quest but it is obtainable in Forever. action "blacklist": Questie lists the quest but Forever does not offer it. Every field is required and the build fails otherwise: {questID, action, evidence: {date, character, observation, source}, addedBy}. Never add entries automatically.
